title: Escapement factory plan critique
description: The plan critic's response to a draft plan and validation contract, before plan approval (docs/FACTORY_DESIGN.md §3.5), and the host's record of what became of each finding (§7.2). This schema checks shape only; `factory check-critique` also checks the rules between fields (every checklist item judged once, unique finding IDs, a concern backed by a finding, approve with no blocking finding, revise or escalate with at least one finding, and with --final a disposition for every finding).

verdict.description: approve: the plan can go to the operator as it is. revise: the planner should address the findings (one round). escalate: the operator must decide something the planner can't, such as splitting the issue.

tier_raise.description: Raise the proposed risk tier. Raise-only: a critic never lowers a tier.

checklist.description: One entry per checklist item, each exactly once.

severity.description: blocking: the plan or contract would fail validation or prove the wrong thing. major: a real gap the plan should close. minor: worth a look.

ref.description: What the finding is about: a criterion (AC-2), an evidence item (AC-2.e1), a task or a file.

dispositions.description: Written by the host after the critique round, not by the critic: what became of each finding. Accepted findings name the plan change they caused; rejected ones say why.

unresolved.description: The planner and the critic disagreed (or the critic escalated), so the operator saw both positions and decided.
